bug_semantics: The frontend rating endpoint accepts an attacker-controlled positive cnvMessageID, resolves that global message directly, and emits its rating. Before the fix it did not bind the resolved message to the conversation represented by the current block, so a requester with any usable conversation context could enumerate IDs belonging to other or restricted conversations, distinguish existing messages, and obtain their rating scores.
flaw_origin: Commit 50a7913e82c5fc28c910b276e5aa1cfb2433fd71 first added web/concrete/tools/conversations/get_rating.php. Its immediate parent has no such path, and the new endpoint performs the vulnerable direct global message lookup and rating output without checking conversation ownership. Later commits change score aggregation, move paths, and refactor controllers but preserve that authorization omission until the 9.5.1 security fix.
